read.speaker: Faded Journal
read.text: The ink has bled and faded, but a few lines are still legible: "...the fever won't break. Every remedy I know has failed. I will not accept that. There must be a formula I haven't tried."
read.text_zh: 墨跡早已暈開褪色，僅剩幾行仍可辨識：「……高燒始終不退。我所知的每一種藥方都失敗了。我不接受這個結果。一定還有我沒試過的配方。」
